name: WorkMate Pro
worktreeHint: Windows desktop required. Build in each checkout; never share dist/artifacts or user data. Run python -X utf8 scripts/run_checks.py.
notes: Baseline: GitHub v1.26.0 b4398a57c0876984f3d6408cae5361fe516179b3; project-prep v0.1.0 441d2c732a7c3718acd5b499dccf3e9c218b2925.
Versioning remains release-owned through AssemblyInfo.cs, app.manifest and release documentation. No npm version helper applies.
Local merges only. Remote push, signed update packages and GitHub releases require separate authorization.
The full local gate includes default 12 sequential and 6 parallel self-tests and real WPF custom-pet UI checks; CI currently runs a smaller suite.
